name: security-audit
description: Source-first security audits with scan planning, scanner-result triage, baseline comparison, and report exports.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence-based security audit workflows. Plan local scans, import supported scanner reports as unverified leads, compare baselines, and export Markdown or SARIF using the bundled Node.js toolkit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this repository's security and explain the evidence, coverage, and remaining gaps.
